explanation: The ui-change workflow now says the router runs one navigation attempt at a time with its own history write policy: a new shell control that moves the explorer calls supersede() before navigate, and a value a view reports back starts an attempt only when it changes. appRouter.ts gains supersede on AppRouter and a verified openInExplorer(id, track); App.tsx routes its track, tab, contrast, leave-Compare and send-genes controls through it. AppView stays declared in appRouter.ts.
